exceptions.title: ignores a delayed touch click immediately after focus opens another menu
exceptions.reason: The case renders a test menubar whose menus have `Menu.Trigger`, `Menu.Popup`, `Menu.Item` and a submenu with `Menu.SubmenuTrigger`. Vase UI does not have these parts of Menu.

exceptions.title: closes on a touch item click immediately after focus opens another menu
exceptions.reason: The case renders a test menubar whose menus have `Menu.Trigger`, `Menu.Popup`, `Menu.Item` and a submenu with `Menu.SubmenuTrigger`. Vase UI does not have these parts of Menu.

exceptions.title: keeps focus on an outside target when a triggerless menubar menu closes
exceptions.reason: The case renders `Menu.Portal`, `Menu.Positioner`, `Menu.Popup` and `Menu.Item` in a `Menu.Root` of the menubar. Vase UI does not have these parts of Menu. The cases of this file that render a menu are ported together, when the last part of Menu that the test menubars render is there.

Each case of the block but one renders one of three test menubars, or renders `Menu.Trigger` in the menubar. The menus of a test menubar have `Menu.Trigger`, `Menu.Popup`, `Menu.Item` and a submenu with `Menu.SubmenuTrigger`. Vase UI does not have these parts of Menu. The case `role > sets aria-orientation on the root element` renders only the menubar, in the `describe.for` of the three test menubars. `Menubar.test.tsx` has cases of its own for the role and for `aria-orientation` of the menubar.

exceptions.title: renders detached top-level portal ownership without an accessibility role
exceptions.reason: The case renders a test menubar whose menus have `Menu.Trigger`, `Menu.Popup`, `Menu.Item` and a submenu with `Menu.SubmenuTrigger`. Vase UI does not have these parts of Menu.

Each case of the block renders `Menu.Trigger`, `Menu.Popup` and `Menu.Item` in the menubar. Vase UI does not have these parts of Menu. The cases of this file that render a menu are ported together, when the last part of Menu that the test menubars render is there.
The case of the block renders `Menu.FilterProvider`, `Menu.Input` and `Menu.List`, which Vase UI does not have.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `id` to give it to the menus of the menubar as the id of their root, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the menubar, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.
